_comment: Reference documents for the performance budget suite (rules/canvas.md §26; performance P3). These five are the ONLY legitimate measurement surfaces. Concrete structural parameters are [PROPOSED] until the budget-suite implementation ADR confirms them; the categories themselves are law.
_status: spec-only — generator emits .gip files once the format v0 exists (ADR-003)

budgets._source: rules/canvas.md §26 (PROPOSED values are binding defaults until ADR confirmation)

documents.purpose: raw node-count scale — culling, painting, selection, panel virtualization

structure.layout: 10x10 grid of frames, each holding 100 mixed nodes (rect / ellipse / text)

documents.purpose: editable vector scale — geometry ops, hit-testing precision, editing responsiveness

structure.hero_path: single editable vector with 1000 points (mixed corner/smooth, both handle modes)
structure.curves: cubic segments majority, some degenerate (zero-length, coincident points)

documents.purpose: media lifecycle + batching — texture management, off-screen release, draw-call proportionality

structure.images: 1 image instance per frame (500 references to a small pool of cached assets)
structure.scrolling: layout arranged so panning crosses frame boundaries constantly

documents.purpose: matrix accumulation + subtree-scoped invalidation without recursion blowups

structure.transforms: rotation + fractional translation at every level (float precision stress)

documents.purpose: effect pipeline + visual-bounds caching — blur/shadow costs, effect isolation, zoom LOD

structure.stacking: blurred containers holding shadowed children (nested effect isolation)
structure.blend_modes: a mix of normal + multiply + screen nodes
structure.fill_complexity: gradients on half of the nodes
